answer: Trellis-Bound Device Attestation. Each identity must anchor to a distinct hardware security module whose die embeds copper eFuses holding a factory-unique key; the registry checks the fuse signature against a per-die manifest. One operator physically cannot fake the fuse pattern, since cloning requires decapping and focused-ion-beam repair of each chip. A sparrow-drone fleet needs one fabricated HSM per identity, costing roughly $40–90 per chip plus wafer-level provisioning.
